scoring_justification: Recomputing the singularity orders requires a full FEM eigenvalue solver which is not feasible in the lightweight checker; result-level comparison against paper-reported values with tolerance is used.

outputs.description: Admissible stress singularity exponents for a crack touching the gamma/beta interface under Mode I remote loading.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the submitted lambda_A and lambda_B to the paper-reported values using a relative tolerance. Only the two eigenvalues in the open interval (0,1) are considered.
